title: Hindsight relabeling on bit-flipping
brief: Write the sparse goal reward and the hindsight relabeling strategies, then train a goal-conditioned DQN on 12-bit bit-flipping with and without relabeling and watch only the relabeled agent learn. Finish with the targets for goal-conditioned supervised learning.
hints: goal_reward compares along the last axis: np.all(achieved == goal, axis=-1) is True where every bit matches. Turn that into 0.0 and -1.0 with np.where.
In relabel, the goal that step t achieved is states[t + 1], not states[t]. For "future", draw j with rng.integers(t + 1, T + 1, size=k). The upper bound is exclusive.
After you change the goal, recompute the reward with goal_reward(s2, g) and set done to r == 0. Copying the original reward leaves a relabeled success marked as a failure.
In dqn_loss, compute the target inside torch.no_grad(), and multiply the bootstrap term by (1 - done) so a transition that reached its goal has target r.
In train_gcdqn, call relabel with the same strategy every episode and extend one list. Strategy "none" gives you plain goal-conditioned DQN.
gcsl_targets is relabel's "future" rule with k = 1, returned as arrays: for each t, one goal states[j] with j in t + 1 .. T.
